:::{#hero-intro}
I'm a BYU student who turns messy data into clear answers. I write **SQL** to pull and join data,
analyze it in **R** and **Python**, and deliver the results as reports and dashboards that
non-technical readers can act on. In my data integration role, I cut a 15-hour ETL job to
10 minutes.
